ambient: K a field; F,N,u1,u2,U in K[X]; a,b in K
premises: F separable (used only to derive F prime(a)!=0)

steps.reason: Exact ActualNonbranchNorm.source_norm_identity, not an assumed normalized norm.
Rearrange S1 in the polynomial ring; no division by b or leading residual coefficient.
Evaluate S1 with F(a)=0 and P(a)=0; K is a field, hence reduced.
Formal derivative of S2, N(a)=0, b!=0 and F'(a)!=0. No cancellation by 2.
A zero polynomial has zero derivative. P'(a)!=0 excludes P=0 and each zero factor.
P(a)=0 gives multiplicity>=1. Multiplicity>1 would force P'(a)=0; contradiction.
Apply product root multiplicity twice with the derived nonzero product.

characteristic: No characteristic-zero or 2!=0 premise is needed for this base-polynomial derivation. In characteristic 2 the squared term derivative vanishes identically, and the surviving -b^2 F prime term remains nonzero under the stated premises. No geometric branch/DVR conclusion is inferred.
scales: U is the actual unnormalized residual C(c^2)X^2+C(q)X+C(r). c may be zero; no normalization by c or c^2 occurs. b is coefficientData first component.

premise_controls.result: Identity holds, F simple, support zero, product multiplicity2.
